name: kisaansahyog
description: KisaanSahyog — a mobile-first PWA for crop advisory, soil health, mandi prices, and farmer skills.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @kisaansahyog/shared && concurrently -n web,api -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @kisaansahyog/web" "npm run dev -w @kisaansahyog/api"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @kisaansahyog/shared && npm run dev -w @kisaansahyog/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kisaansahyog/shared && npm run build -w @kisaansahyog/skills && npm run build -w @kisaansahyog/api && npm run build -w @kisaansahyog/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @kisaansahyog/shared && npm run build -w @kisaansahyog/skills && npm run typecheck -w @kisaansahyog/api && npm run typecheck -w @kisaansahyog/web
scripts.clean: node -e "const { rmSync } = require('node:fs'); for (const dir of ['apps/web/dist', 'apps/api/dist', 'packages/shared/dist', 'packages/skills/dist']) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });"
